recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-14696 unless a future ballot intentionally revisits ValueSet $expand input parameter requirements.
issue_request: FHIR-14696 was Published with resolution Persuasive for STU3 and asked that the ValueSet $expand operation's non-instance invocation sentence replace the nonexistent in parameter "constraint" with "url".
initial_application: The Jira comment records pre-application in SVN build@13351. Git-svn commit d90f55e1cbc897c77c5188342e1d43353f38f2c3 included GF#14696 and changed the old source/valueset/valueset-spreadsheet.xml $expand description from "constraint, context or valueset" to "url, context or valueSet". The 2021 source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 then moved the carried-forward corrected text into source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists valueset=ValueSet, and source/valueset/list-ValueSet-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/ValueSet-expand, so the checked OperationDefinition is in current build scope. The current OperationDefinition defines url, valueSet, and context input parameters and its description already references those parameters. FHIR-14699 is an analogous same-batch $validate-code wording issue already represented by a separate combined-branch audit commit. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip discussion, and a Vocabulary block-vote Confluence page lists tracker 14696 as Persuasive and pre-applied.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current authoritative ValueSet $expand source already satisfies the requested correction, and targeted source searches found no remaining stale ValueSet operation wording that names a nonexistent "constraint" input.
